trigger: the owner's DIR-6 order: separate genuine physics errors (MECHANISM/MISSING_VALIDATION) from STATED_PARAM assumption disputes; do not re-label a wrong-signed relation as an 'assumption dispute'
finding: the objection_class assignment keyed on WHETHER THE JUDGE DISPUTES A STATED QUANTITY, not on WHETHER THE DISPUTED PHYSICS IS WRONG — the class over-captures: sign reversals, magnitude impossibilities, formula invalidities and mechanism-class impossibilities landed in STATED_PARAM whenever the judge phrased the objection as a parameter dispute
verification_scope: the 6 owner-named genuine physics errors, all 15 rulings over them

per_row_corrections.ground: a screen cannot remove dissolved non-magnetic ions by a magnetic-gradient mechanism — mechanism-class-at-scale impossibility
the candidate concedes the gradient force is negligible on dissolved ions — mechanism-class impossibility
cathodic protection of a titanium ANODE shorted to the same anodic bus — polarity/mechanism incoherence
142 kJ vs ~100 m2 duct wall — first-principles energy-balance magnitude impossibility
adding mass LOWERS the natural frequency the candidate claims to raise — wrong-signed relation
single-layer field formula misapplied to a graded bushing — formula-validity error
permittivity in F/m (dimensionally wrong) + invalid field formula — formula-validity + units error
field-reduction relation physically REVERSED for series dielectric layers — wrong-signed relation
capacitance-divider model does not hold for the claimed ~2x reduction — formula-validity/sign error

reclassification_rule: STATED_PARAM only when the candidate's stated value is arbitrary-but-physically-POSSIBLE (an assumption an auditor could accept or bound); MECHANISM when the mechanism class itself cannot act at the stated scale; MISSING_VALIDATION when a stated formula/units/sign/magnitude is WRONG (a falsifiable physics error, never a taste dispute); sign reversals and magnitude impossibilities are NEVER assumption disputes
downstream: feeds the c-0258 physics lever's check classes (sign, magnitude, formula validity, mechanism-class-at-scale) — the generation-time gate must classify its own rejections by the same rule; the qualified-panel viable votes on v18 arbitrate the corrected reading
